notes.title: Bug fixes, polishing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added pathfinding to the ghost AI, allowing it to move around furniture to get to you.
[*] AI ghosthunts last longer.
[*] Thermometer now checks temperature on the laser point in front of it, instead of directly on the thermo gun position.
[*] The EMF and geiger counter now display corrupt numbers when the house hasn't been cleansed.
[*] Added a description for crucifixes on the computer.
[*] Moved the video camera to the computer to make it easier to spot.
[*] Made a change to held items, preventing them from clipping through walls.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Crucifixes should now work vs ghost players.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it neccessary for you to cleanse in training mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the ghost from killing players.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented ghost footsteps from making a sound.
[*] The video camera display has been fixes, no longer making objects clip out randomly.
[*] Fixed some bugs with doors, should hopefully work properly now.
[/list]

notes.title: New update - Singleplayer mode + more!
notes.content:
This update contains an AI for the ghost, meaning you can finally play Fear the Phantom solo! The ghost AI is also available for multiplayer through the settings program on the computer in the lobby.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Bug fixes and quality of life
notes.content:
Light switches now indicate whether or not the lights are on by the model. Random hints are visible on the kitchen fridge to help with identifying ghosts. There is now a bar showing you how long your hunt will last when playing as the ghost.

Some of the bug fixes include:
The ghost model should now render correctly during hunts. The bugged ghost orb should no longer appear.

notes.title: Ragdolls, cameras, ghost variants
notes.content: I was planning on getting this update out earlier, but since I've been sick, it's been hard to work the last few days. Well, now it's released and it's a significant update. First of all, ghost variants now play a bigger role. Ghost hunters can gather evidence to guess the ghost type for better rewards (on the computer) before exorcising. After the game has ended, they can view the computer to see if their guess was correct. We also got ragdoll physics for dead players, which makes killing more fun as a ghost. There is also a camera in game which can be used to spot ghost orbs. They are pretty difficult to spot right now, so it will be tweaked later. Ghost orbs can be spotted where energy orbs spawn for the ghost.

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: Been working on some optimization to make the game run better. Added some quality settings, and added occlusion culling. I believe there are still things left to do but since my framerate was significantly better with this update, I felt it was important to publish it. Also fixed some bugs regarding picking up items. Players should no longer be able to "steal" other player's held objects.

notes.title: New medium update
notes.content:
Did some changes to the looks of the geiger counter and EMF reader, as well as added some audio to them. Added a screen in the lobby to display some lobby info, and added some more settings to the lobby settings program on the PC. Working on some optimization, as it seems like the framerate might be dropping after adding the basement. 

Also got some new character animations, so it should look better now. Still some work to be done there.

notes.title: Small patch with bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug with locked doors. The crucifix should also work as intended now.

notes.title: First round of playtesters getting access this weekend
notes.content:
Hey!

I think the game is getting close to something I can share with some playtesters now. We've been doing a lot of testing internally, but I want more people to play it so I can get more feedback. Many of the most common bugs have been fixed. I've added a tutorial as well, as it was a little bit hard to figure out how to play as a ghost hunter. 

The game is still very minimal, but I think it's important right now to get a lot of feedback so I can take a direction with the game that people like. We have had a lot of fun with the game in this minimal state, so building on top of that will make Fear the Phantom a great game in the future. 

I am planning on giving access to a bunch of playtesters this weekend, starting Friday 02/24. If this goes nicely, I will keep giving access to more and more players over the upcoming days. 

If you are interested in getting inside information, or just talk with me or the community, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/puHu5RAE2k]Discord[/url].
